scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
official_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (formerly Kalaignar Kaappittu Thittam), Government of Tamil Nadu

responsible_department.value: Reported inconsistently as either the Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Department OR the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

implementing_authority: Implemented via United India Insurance Company under the Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (TNHSP) for the 2022-2027 cycle.
description: Tamil Nadu's flagship state health insurance scheme launched 23 July 2009, providing cashless treatment to economically weaker households (and certain special categories) through empanelled government and private hospitals.
target_population: Economically weaker Tamil Nadu households identified via ration/family card and an (unverified) income ceiling; plus special categories such as differently-abled persons, transgender persons, journalists, Sri Lankan Tamil refugees, and orphaned/rescued children.
